subject: SIG evidence delivery - playbooks, topology screenshots, access checklist
messages:
From: Laura Chen <ciso@praxishealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Boyd <alice@vendorsecure.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — topology, runbooks, KMS proof

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG review we need evidence for a handful of items so our security team can close the open questions:

- Network topology that shows segmentation between customer workloads and control plane (annotated PNG or PDF).
- Ops/runbooks for incident response and emergency access (redacted is fine; we need the steps, owners, and escalation path).
- KMS key rotation proof and screenshots of the key management console showing rotation settings (or rotation logs).
- A short access checklist that lists who can request break-glass and the approval flow.

Can you deliver these to a shared Drive folder and reply with links + any known gaps by EOD Monday (2026-09-21)? If you need changes to the scope let me know.

Laura Chen
CISO, PraxisHealth

-Karthik

On Mon, Sep 21, 2026 at 08:45 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — I've uploaded the first pass of the runbooks and a redaction plan. Links below:
> Drive folder (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSIG-Praxis-Evidence

Thanks — I exported the annotated network topology and included an excerpt from the network runbook that maps services to segments.

Files uploaded to the shared folder: network-topology-annotated.png, ops-playbook-network.pdf

Quick summary of what the topology shows:
- Control plane (management) is isolated in its own VPC with strict SGs; customer inference traffic is on separate subnets and NAT gateways.
- No direct inbound access to control plane; admin access goes through a bastion with MFA and ephemeral session tokens.
- We documented the jump host flow in ops-playbook-network.pdf and included the emergency break-glass approval path.

If you want higher-resolution screenshots for any component (bastion, VPC route tables, KMS console) tell me which one and I'll pull them.

--
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
